title: Peruvian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Peruvian-inspired stew made with aromatic potatoes and tender beef.
instructions: Heat the beef broth in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the beef stew meat to the pot and cook until browned.
Add the Peruvian potatoes to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Season the stew with stew seasoning and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
